# apple_ci_workflow (Resource)

Manages an Xcode Cloud workflow: its actions, start conditions and Xcode/macOS versions. The product and SCM connection must already exist in Xcode Cloud.

~> **Post-actions and environment variables are not managed.** Apple's API does not expose them. Configure TestFlight distribution, notifications and environment variables in Xcode or App Store Connect. `build_distribution_audience` controls archive eligibility, not distribution.

A manual test confirmed that an environment variable and an email notification survived a description-only update. Other UI-only settings and update types have not been tested.

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "product_id" {
  type        = string
  description = "Existing Xcode Cloud product ID. Set up the product in Xcode first."
}
variable "repository_id" {
  type        = string
  description = "Existing connected SCM repository ID."
}
variable "xcode_version_id" {
  type        = string
  description = "Xcode version ID from apple_ci_xcode_versions."
}
variable "mac_os_version_id" {
  type        = string
  description = "Compatible macOS version ID from apple_ci_mac_os_versions."
}

resource "apple_ci_workflow" "main" {
  name                = "Main"
  description         = "Build and test main"
  is_enabled          = false
  clean               = false
  container_file_path = "App.xcodeproj"
  product_id          = var.product_id
  repository_id       = var.repository_id
  xcode_version_id    = var.xcode_version_id
  mac_os_version_id   = var.mac_os_version_id

  branch_start_condition = {
    source      = { patterns = [{ pattern = "main", is_prefix = false }] }
    auto_cancel = true
    files_and_folders_rule = {
      mode     = "START_IF_ANY_FILE_MATCHES"
      matchers = [{ file_extension = "swift" }]
    }
  }
  tag_start_condition = {
    source = { patterns = [{ pattern = "v", is_prefix = true }] }
  }
  pull_request_start_condition = {
    source      = { is_all_match = true }
    destination = { patterns = [{ pattern = "main", is_prefix = false }] }
    auto_cancel = true
  }
  scheduled_start_condition = {
    source = { patterns = [{ pattern = "main", is_prefix = false }] }
    schedule = {
      frequency = "WEEKLY"
      days      = ["MONDAY"]
      hour      = 9
      minute    = 0
      timezone  = "Europe/Warsaw"
    }
  }
  manual_branch_start_condition = { source = { is_all_match = true } }
  manual_tag_start_condition    = { source = { is_all_match = true } }
  manual_pull_request_start_condition = {
    source      = { is_all_match = true }
    destination = { is_all_match = true }
  }
  actions = [
    {
      action_type         = "BUILD"
      scheme              = "App"
      platform            = "IOS"
      destination         = "ANY_IOS_DEVICE"
      is_required_to_pass = true
    },
    {
      action_type         = "TEST"
      scheme              = "App"
      platform            = "IOS"
      is_required_to_pass = true
      test_configuration = {
        kind = "USE_SCHEME_SETTINGS"
        test_destinations = [{
          kind                   = "SIMULATOR"
          device_type_identifier = "com.apple.CoreSimulator.SimDeviceType.iPhone-14-Pro"
          runtime_identifier     = "default"
        }]
      }
    },
    {
      action_type         = "ANALYZE"
      scheme              = "App"
      platform            = "IOS"
      destination         = "ANY_IOS_DEVICE"
      is_required_to_pass = true
    },
    {
      action_type                 = "ARCHIVE"
      scheme                      = "App"
      platform                    = "IOS"
      destination                 = "ANY_IOS_DEVICE"
      is_required_to_pass         = true
      build_distribution_audience = "APP_STORE_ELIGIBLE"
    }
  ]
}

# Configure post-actions and environment variables/secrets in App Store Connect.
# Archive eligibility above does not configure TestFlight distribution.
```

## Schema

### Required

- `actions` (Attributes List) Ordered workflow actions. Supports build, test, analyze and archive. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--actions))
- `clean` (Boolean) Start builds with a clean environment.
- `container_file_path` (String) Repository-relative `.xcodeproj` or `.xcworkspace` path.
- `description` (String) Workflow description; may be empty.
- `is_enabled` (Boolean) Whether the workflow can start builds.
- `mac_os_version_id` (String) Apple relationship ID.
- `name` (String) Workflow name.
- `product_id` (String) Apple relationship ID.
- `repository_id` (String) Apple relationship ID.
- `xcode_version_id` (String) Apple relationship ID.

### Optional

- `branch_start_condition` (Attributes) When to start builds. Removing this condition disables the trigger. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--branch_start_condition))
- `manual_branch_start_condition` (Attributes) When to start builds. Removing this condition disables the trigger. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--manual_branch_start_condition))
- `manual_pull_request_start_condition` (Attributes) When to start builds. Removing this condition disables the trigger. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--manual_pull_request_start_condition))
- `manual_tag_start_condition` (Attributes) When to start builds. Removing this condition disables the trigger. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--manual_tag_start_condition))
- `pull_request_start_condition` (Attributes) When to start builds. Removing this condition disables the trigger. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--pull_request_start_condition))
- `scheduled_start_condition` (Attributes) Scheduled branch builds. Omit to disable scheduled starts. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--scheduled_start_condition))
- `tag_start_condition` (Attributes) When to start builds. Removing this condition disables the trigger. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tag_start_condition))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Apple workflow ID.

<a id="nestedatt--actions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `actions`

Required:

- `action_type` (String) `BUILD`, `TEST`, `ANALYZE` or `ARCHIVE`.
- `is_required_to_pass` (Boolean) Whether this action must pass for the workflow to succeed.
- `scheme` (String) Shared Xcode scheme.

Optional:

- `build_distribution_audience` (String) Archive eligibility: `INTERNAL_ONLY` or `APP_STORE_ELIGIBLE`. Does not distribute the build.
- `destination` (String) Build destination: `ANY_IOS_DEVICE`, `ANY_IOS_SIMULATOR`, `ANY_TVOS_DEVICE`, `ANY_TVOS_SIMULATOR`, `ANY_WATCHOS_DEVICE`, `ANY_WATCHOS_SIMULATOR`, `ANY_MAC`, `ANY_MAC_CATALYST`, `ANY_VISIONOS_DEVICE` or `ANY_VISIONOS_SIMULATOR`.
- `platform` (String) `MACOS`, `IOS`, `TVOS`, `WATCHOS` or `VISIONOS`.
- `test_configuration` (Attributes) Test plans and destinations for a TEST action. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--actions--test_configuration))

Read-Only:

- `name` (String) The action's display name, normalized by Apple — for example, `Build - iOS`.

<a id="nestedatt--actions--test_configuration"></a>
### Nested Schema for `actions.test_configuration`

Optional:

- `kind` (String) `USE_SCHEME_SETTINGS` or `SPECIFIC_TEST_PLANS`.
- `test_destinations` (Attributes List) Test devices and runtimes; discover available values with `apple_ci_xcode_versions`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--actions--test_configuration--test_destinations))
- `test_plan_name` (String) Test plan name when selecting a specific test plan.

<a id="nestedatt--actions--test_configuration--test_destinations"></a>
### Nested Schema for `actions.test_configuration.test_destinations`

Optional:

- `device_type_identifier` (String) Device type identifier.
- `device_type_name` (String) Device display name.
- `kind` (String) `SIMULATOR` or `MAC`.
- `runtime_identifier` (String) Runtime identifier.
- `runtime_name` (String) Runtime display name.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
# Import an existing workflow by its Apple ID.
terraform import apple_ci_workflow.main "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000"
```
